cohort: Pregnant women with COVID-19 at a tertiary referral hospital in Surabaya, Indonesia, from June to August 2021
finding: Pregnant women with severe/critical COVID-19 had worse outcomes including lower gestational age at delivery, slower onset of disease/symptoms, higher maternal death proportions, worse clinical symptoms, vital signs, and inflammatory markers, higher cesarean section rates, lower birth weight, lower Apgar score, and higher incidence of perinatal deaths and neonatal support compared to women with asymptomatic/mild or moderate disease.
mod_finding: Severe COVID-19 cases had a higher cesarean section rate.
gest_age: Lower gestational age in the severe-critical group
birth_weight: Lower birth weight in the severe-critical group
